title: Chapter 203 Rely On Yourself
content:
Chapter 203 Rely On Yourself

When Lu Xue heard this news, both of them were stunned.

After reacting, the two of them became excited.

"Dad and the others are finally back."

Immediately, the three of them rushed towards the city gate without stopping.

At the same time, at the city gate.

"I have met the city lord!"

Huang Shou and the other two saluted respectfully at Lu Daosheng and the other two.

Lu Daosheng pulled Yan Lingyun and stood in front of the city gate, looking at the three of them with a smile.

"How does the fairy world feel?"

Huang Shou nodded and said, "Master Lord, the environment in the fairy world is very good, but I don't know how strong the people here are."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng's smile became even worse.

"Then you should know soon."

At this time, several figures rushed towards this place from the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng looked up and saw them immediately.

There are Lu Xue, Gu Chen and Wan Feng, Jiangbei, Yu Qingfeng and others, Shen Yi and others who were once the Divine Dynasty, Qin Yi, Mu Chen, Xu Qingzhi and others who were once the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm. After that, They are the three major families in the deserted city.

These people were brought by Lu Daosheng from the lower realm.

Now, when Lu Daosheng was aware of his return, he rushed to greet him.

"Dad, mom!"

"Master, Master."

"We've seen the city lord!"

Looking at the people in front of him, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Enter the city!"

Immediately, a group of people entered the city gate in a mighty manner and headed straight for the city lord's mansion.

When pedestrians on the road saw this scene, they were watching and watching, but they did not dare to say much.

Because the person in the leader is the most popular and most powerful existence in the Wood Immortal World now, the Lord of the Wilderness City!

Everyone looked at the Lord of Huangcheng and led the people of Huangcheng to walk past with a solemn expression.

These people are all powerful geniuses from all over the Wood Immortal Realm. Their main purpose is to take a look at the terrifying existence in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

When everyone looked at it, they looked solemn.

There was no breath at all, but it was because of this that everyone was even more shocked.

The aura of the strong is not revealed.

In a loft, two old men looked at the large troops on the street, their faces becoming heavy.

"I really didn't expect that the Lord of the Wilderness City was so terrifying. I dare say that even in the Central Domain, the Lord of the Wilderness City is enough to rank among the top."

The old man with white eyebrows spoke first.

On the side, the old man with long hair nodded slightly, but at this time, his expression suddenly became stunned.

"What do you think of the woman next to the Lord of the Huangcheng City?"

Looking at Yan Lingyun beside Lu Daosheng, the old man with long hair suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, the old man with white eyebrows looked in the direction and immediately noticed Yan Lingyun.

"this,,"

For a moment, the old man with white eyebrows suddenly became solemn.

"She is far above us."

Just a glance, the old man with white eyebrows made his own judgment.

On the side, the old man with long hair was silent. Obviously, he did not deny this judgment.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun suddenly looked towards the two of them on the street.

Suddenly, the two of them seemed to fall into the abyss, sweating profusely.

After reacting, Yan Lingyun had already walked away, leaving only the two of them standing there and sweating profusely.

"So strong."

The old man with white eyebrows wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.

The old man on the side nodded, "What should we do next?"

After a long silence, the old man with white eyebrows made a decision.

"How about we join this deserted city?"

"What?!"

As soon as these words were said, the old man with long hair suddenly looked at the old man with a nose blowing and staring at the old man with white eyebrows, "Do you want to give up?"

Faced with the questioning of the old man with long hair, the old man with white eyebrows shook his head.

"No, I'm not giving up. Only the two of us can't do that. We are here in the Wood Fairy Realm, just trying to try our luck and see if we can find someone with ability to help us? ”

"Now, you have also seen the strength of the Lord of the Huangcheng City. Even if it really doesn't work, with his strength, the chance will definitely be greater than ours."

Hearing this, the old man with long hair hesitated for a long time, but he finally nodded.

"But if this is the case, we will have to rely on others."

The old man with white eyebrows looked up at the sky, "What is this sacrifice for the sake of the family?"

Finally, the two set out toward the city lord's mansion.

In the city lord's mansion.

"Everyone, next, Huangcheng will ask everyone."

Standing at the top of the hall, Lu Daosheng waved his hand and smiled.

Hearing this, everyone was stunned.

"Sir, where are you going?"

However, Lu Daosheng chuckled and said, "I won't go anywhere."

With a light cough, Lu Daosheng's expression also became serious.

"The fairy world is vast, and it is not comparable to the lower world. Our next road will inevitably be much more difficult, so I will also be in seclusion for a while."

As soon as these words came out, everyone's expressions became solemn.

Unexpectedly, the pressure in the fairy world was so great that even the city lord, who had always been invincible, was about to go into seclusion.

This was basically impossible in the past.

However, in fact, Lu Daosheng just wanted to be a hand-off manager.

Retreat, haha, you still need to practice?

Yan Lingyun stood beside Lu Daosheng, and couldn't help but worry about what happened next in the Huangcheng.

This guy is too irresponsible.

Now the core figures of Huangcheng, such as Huangshou, have not caught up yet, but Lu Daosheng is going to be a hands-off boss.

This pressure is very great.

Of course, Lu Daosheng also has his own ideas.

The current Huangcheng needs a period of sedimentation.

Otherwise, it is easy to drift if you move too fast.

Just like the Huangcheng in the Spirit Realm now, although Huangcheng has been regarded as the first force by the Wood Immortal Realm, in fact, the only ones who can really fight in the entire Huangcheng are Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun, followed by Wanfeng.

So the status and strength of Huangcheng are still somewhat inconsistent.

After careful consideration, Lu Daosheng decided to let Huangcheng develop for a while, and when the time is right, he will lead Huangcheng to march into the Central Region.

"Don't worry, Lord City Lord, we will definitely not let you down."

Gu Chen, Awei and others stepped forward and said.

The others also responded.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

After a while, everyone left the hall.

Inside the hall.

"Daosheng, are you really not going to care?"

Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Daosheng and said.

Looking at Yan Lingyun, Lu Daosheng shook his head, "They should also face some things independently."

"Besides, isn't there still Wanfeng?"

Inside the hall, Wanfeng and Lu Xue had not left yet.

After hearing what Lu Daosheng said, Wanfeng also understood what Lu Daosheng meant.

"Master, don't worry, I'm here, nothing will happen."

On the side, Lu Xue hesitated for a moment, and just as she was about to speak, Xun Heng suddenly entered the hall.

Then, Xun Heng respectfully saluted the people in the hall one by one.

After all, the four people in the hall are now the highest-ranking in the deserted city.

After the salute, Xun Heng spoke to Lu Daosheng.

"Lord City Lord, there are two people who claim to be from the Central Region and want to see you."
